newsitem.title: UK: GOLF-VOLVO MASTERS PRIZE MONEY UP TO ONE MILLION STERLING.
newsitem.headline: GOLF-VOLVO MASTERS PRIZE MONEY UP TO ONE MILLION STERLING.

text.p: Prize money for the Volvo Masters, final event of the European Tour season, has been increased by 100,000 pounds sterling ($163,000) to one million pounds ($1.63 million), Volvo announced on Tuesday.
This year's event from October 30 to November 2 will be played at the Jack Nicklaus-designed Montecastillo course.
Volvo also announced increased prize money of 100,000 pounds to 1.1 million pounds ($1.79 million) for the British PGA championship at Wentworth in May.
